source: NSE official corporate filings (XBRL) — Financial Results (Reg 33) + Shareholding Pattern (Reg 31), fetched via the nse python package v3.2.1 hitting nseindia.com / nsearchives.nseindia.com directly. No third-party/paid data used.
data_notes: Field names are standardized (see SCHEMA.md) — mapped from whichever raw XBRL tag that filing's taxonomy vintage uses, so the same field name works across all years/companies.
Any real financial fact not yet in the canonical map is kept under 'other_facts' on the same block rather than dropped — this is a standardized schema, not a lossy one.
Balance sheet and cash flow are only disclosed by SEBI LODR at half-year (Q2) and full-year (Q4/Annual) filings — Q1/Q3 having none is expected, not missing data.
cash_flow under each quarter is YEAR-TO-DATE cumulative as filed (H1 for Q2, full year for Q4/Annual), never single-quarter — see its own 'period' field.
'annual' is the separately-filed AUDITED full-year result, distinct from the Q4 quarterly filing — both kept since they can differ.

fii_holding_pct/dii_holding_pct are summed from category sub-fields whose names vary by taxonomy vintage (including a real SEBI taxonomy typo, 'Catergory', in older filings) — the full raw 'categories' dict is always kept alongside for verification.

dii_holding_pct falls back to summing Mutual Funds/Banks/Insurance/Pension Fund categories individually when a filing has no single 'InstitutionsDomestic' aggregate tag (older filings) — treat as an approximation for those years.
Dividend-per-share, analyst estimates, and peer/sector data are not present — none exist in these 2 official sources (see REQUIRED_FIELDS.md / DATA_SOURCES.md).
Some quarters/annual blocks were back-filled by fill_missing_quarters.py from NSE legacy Financial Results and Integrated Filing- Financials XBRL (see 'source_filing' on those blocks).

other_facts.NoteForNonApplicabilityOfTheDisclosureFo:
Explanatory Notes to the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results

1 The Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 of SOLAR INDUSTRIES INDIA LIMITED (the "Company") have been reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and subsequently approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meeting held on August 13, 2026. The Company confirms that its statutory auditors have carried out limited review of the aforesaid results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

2 These results have been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standard (referred to as “Ind AS") prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act 2013 read with Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 as amended from time to time.
3 The Company has identified 'Explosives, its accessories and related services', as its only reportable segment as defined under Ind AS 108 - Operating Segments. Accordingly, no separate segment information has been provided.

4 During the quarter ended June 30, 2026, the Company has partially redeemed 292 (Two Hundred and Ninety two) unsecured, rated, listed, senior, redeemable, non-convertible debentures (NCDs) having face value of Rs. 1,00,000/- (One lakh) each amounting to Rs. 2.92 Crores (Two crores and ninety two lakh ) and made an Interest Payment amounting to Rs. 0.21 Crores (Twenty one lakh) at a coupon rate of 7.06% per annum.
As on June 30, 2026 the aggregate amount of outstanding NCD is Rs. 8.75 Crores (Eight crore seventy five lakhs).
5 During the quarter ended June 30, 2026, the Company has issued Commercial Paper in favour of Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited amounting to Rs. 75.00 Crores which will mature on September 17, 2026.
6 Formulae for the computation of ratios are given in Annexure A.
7 The figures of the last quarter ended March 31, 2026 are the balancing figures between the audited figures in respect of the full financial year ended March 31, 2026 and the published year-to-date figures up to the third quarter of the financial year.
8 As per Regulation 46(2) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Results are available on Company's website-www.solargroup.com.
